items.title: Welcome to RPG Battle!
items.body: A Suikoden II-inspired turn-based RPG battle game built with Pygame. Fight enemies, collect spoils, and enjoy the journey.

items.title: Launcher v1.0 released
items.body: The new launcher brings light and dark themes with persistent settings, plus a news carousel to keep you up to date.

items.title: New spell animations
items.body: Spells now feature glowing effects, particles and projectiles that bring every combat to life.

items.title: Fight epic battles
items.body: Real sprites, four battle backgrounds and thrilling turn-based encounters inspired by the classics of the genre.
